messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY PAUSED] Release v2026.03.21 -> prod blocked by preflight: keystore symlink parity check failed (check: keystore-symlink-parity). staging: /etc/redwood/keystore -> s3://staging-keystore/vers1-symlink (empty), prod: s3://prod-keystore/vers1.

maria: saw this from the canary run. staging symlink resolves to nothing so keystore lookups will 404.

kevin: i think infra changed the staging symlink during the key rotation on 2026-03-19. prod still points to the old named dir.

jonathan: can we backfill the staging symlink to match prod instead of rolling back the release? rollback would touch a lot of services.

maria: backfill should be quick — i'll create the symlink-target dir in staging S3 and copy the keys from prod env snapshot. running `aws s3 sync s3://prod-keystore/vers1/ s3://staging-keystore/vers1/ && aws s3 cp s3://staging-keystore/vers1/ s3://staging-keystore/vers1-symlink/ --recursive`

ops-bot: change window: 03/21 18:00-23:59 PT (approved). Any hot changes must be annotated in the release notes.

sam (PM): prefer backfill + recheck. If parity passes, resume canary -> prod. Pin the deploy so we don't accidentally advance to another build while we fix parity.

kevin: agreed. plan: 1) maria backfills staging keys 2) kevin reruns `./scripts/deploy_check --checks=keystore-symlink-parity` 3) deploy-bot will allow resume if check passes. I'll pin the queued release to v2026.03.21 in the deploy queue.

maria: backfill started. copying objects now. i'll post command output when done.

maria: done — objects copied. verification: `aws s3 ls s3://staging-keystore/vers1-symlink/` shows 42 objects.

kevin: re-running check now. `./scripts/deploy_check --checks=keystore-symlink-parity --target=staging`

kevin: check output: PASS — symlink resolves to vers1 and checksum matches prod snapshot.

deploy-bot: [QUEUED RELEASE] Preflight checks now green for queued release id 8421. Resume permitted by approver.

maria: resuming deploybot?

kevin: resume triggered. `deployctl resume 8421`

deploy-bot: [RESUMED] Release 8421 progressing to canary. Monitoring logs for keystore access errors.

sam (PM): :thumbsup: leaving a short note in the release notes: "Staging keystore symlink backfilled to match prod (prevented false-negative preflight); no rollback required." Also opening a small follow-up to add this parity check to our staging-sync job.

jonathan: filing followup ticket now — add keystore symlink reconciliation to nightly staging-sync + alert if symlink target missing.

maria: thanks everyone. will add a quick blurb to the deploy runbook about verifying symlink targets when rotating keys. :eyes:

kevin: closing thread once the canary is stable. last check in 15m.
